units.zh: 今天的档案包含 12 条证据记录，来自 3 类来源，覆盖 8 个已记录领域。这首先是一张关于已有资料的个人地图：其中 6 条来自自己的作答，让我们看见你如何理解若干方面的日常运作。
units.en: Today's profile contains 12 evidence records from 3 source classes, covering 8 recorded domains. This is a personal map of the material available: 6 records come from your own responses, showing how you understand several aspects of your functioning.

units.zh: 这些来源让档案能够分别阅读自我理解、测评结果或任务样本。它们的价值在于回答不同问题。明确的来源对照可帮助整理相同主题上的一致与分歧；来源数量本身不会使观点自动获得更多权威。
units.en: These sources let the profile read self-understanding, assessment results or task samples separately. Their value lies in answering different questions. An explicit comparison can organize agreement or disagreement on the same topic; source count alone does not give an account more authority.

units.zh: 来源分层让这份地图保留每一类材料自己的位置。相同主题可以有不同视角；这里展示实际记录的覆盖，而不是把不同来源合成一种测量。
units.en: Source separation preserves each kind of material’s position in the map. The same topic can have different perspectives; this shows recorded coverage rather than combining sources into one measurement.

units.zh: 这里的 8 个领域全部来自现有证据记录，包括适应与应对、身体与生活方式、认知导航、情绪与社交调节、财务能力、意义与价值、推理任务表现、IPIP 大五人格 · 开放性。它们是阅读材料的入口，而不是相互替代的能力分数。财务记录的具体结果在第八章集中呈现，但这个领域仍完整地属于当前证据结构。
units.en: All 8 domains here come from the evidence records: Adaptation and coping, Body and lifestyle, Cognitive navigation, Emotional and social regulation, Financial capability, Meaning and values, Reasoning task performance, IPIP Big Five · Openness. They are entry points into the material, rather than interchangeable ability scores. The detailed financial results appear together in chapter eight, while the domain remains fully represented in the evidence structure.

units.zh: 你的作答让应对压力与变化成为可讨论的经验领域：你已经提供了自己如何看待这部分运作的视角。被打断后重新安排步骤，是区分恢复节奏与持续承受负荷的一处观察点。
units.en: Your response makes coping with pressure and change a visible part of your self-view. It gives us your perspective on this area of functioning. Reorganizing steps after an interruption is one place to distinguish recovering your rhythm from sustaining a demanding workload.

units.zh: 你对身体照顾与日常节奏的看法已进入档案。这使作息、活动与察觉疲劳能够成为具体的观察主题；例如，可以比较计划中的节奏与某一天实际保留了哪些习惯。
units.en: Your view of bodily care and daily rhythm is part of the profile. Routines, activity and noticing fatigue become concrete topics to observe—for example, by comparing an intended routine with the habits actually retained on a particular day.

units.zh: 这一领域使信息理解、推理与落实之间的区别变得清楚。把一个问题说清楚，与在学习新任务时完成下一步，是相互关联却不同的经验；已有记录为核对这种区别提供了起点。
units.en: This area brings the distinction between understanding information, reasoning and following through into focus. Explaining a problem and completing the next step while learning a new task are related but different experiences. The recorded material offers a starting point for comparing them.

units.zh: 情绪与社交调节已成为你描述自己的一个角度。它让察觉感受、表达需要与回应他人能够分别讨论。在一次困难对话中，可以观察这几步如何衔接，而不把一次整体作答当成对整段关系的判断。
units.en: Emotional and social regulation is one angle through which you describe yourself. It allows noticing feelings, expressing needs and responding to another person to be discussed separately. A difficult conversation can reveal how these steps connect, without making one broad response a verdict on a relationship.

units.zh: 金钱事务在已有证据中有自己的位置。它使“如何理解财务能力”成为明确问题：觉得有所准备、理解一个原则与实际执行选择，可以分别核对。意外支出是一种可能让这些区别显现的情境。
units.en: Money-related demands have a place in the available evidence. They make how you understand financial capability a specific question: feeling prepared, understanding a principle and acting on a choice can be examined separately. An unexpected expense is one possible context in which these distinctions become visible.

units.zh: 意义与价值为理解优先事项提供了一个入口。已有描述可以与具体取舍对照：当时间、金钱或长期承诺彼此竞争时，哪些考虑被保留、哪些被调整。这样的核对能让价值从名称变成有情境的理解。
units.en: Meaning and values provide an entry point for understanding priorities. The recorded account can be compared with a concrete trade-off: when time, money or a long-term commitment competes for attention, which considerations are retained and which are adjusted? This makes values a contextual question rather than just a label.

units.zh: 推理任务表现为这份档案保留了一个来源明确的阅读主题。把该记录与一次具体任务或经历对照，能帮助区分来源中的描述与情境中发生的事情。
units.en: Reasoning task performance preserves a source-defined topic in this profile. Comparing that record with a specific task or episode helps distinguish the source account from what happened in a setting.

units.en: IPIP Big Five · Openness preserves a source-defined topic in this profile. Comparing that record with a specific task or episode helps distinguish the source account from what happened in a setting.

units.zh: 关于适应与应对、认知导航、情绪与社交调节、意义与价值的自我描述，为资源与阻力提供了可检验的线索。这些主题可以帮助你区分：什么让一步行动更容易完成，什么在特定条件下增加消耗。当前最有用的读法，是保留线索并观察它在哪种要求下发挥作用。
units.en: Your self-description of Adaptation and coping, Cognitive navigation, Emotional and social regulation, Meaning and values offers testable leads for resources and friction. These topics can help distinguish what makes a next step easier from what adds effort under particular conditions. The useful reading is to retain the lead and observe the demands under which it matters.

units.zh: 同一种做法可能在安静、时间充足时帮助推进，在频繁打断或期限缩短时增加成本。一处可观察的区别是：完成任务是否依赖额外准备、他人支持或恢复时间。记录当时的要求、行动和结果，会比只给自己贴上“优点”或“弱点”的标签更能说明问题。
units.en: The same approach may help in a quiet setting with sufficient time and become costly when interruptions increase or a deadline shortens. One observable distinction is whether completion depends on extra preparation, another person’s support or recovery time. Recording the demands, action and outcome explains more than attaching a strength or weakness label.

units.zh: 这里区分已观察到的帮助或成本，与值得检验的可能线索。看清这个区别，可以选择一次条件明确的行动来核对，而不急于把某种倾向定为优点或缺点。
units.en: This separates recorded help or cost from a possible lead worth testing. The distinction helps select an action with defined conditions for examination, rather than immediately treating a tendency as a strength or weakness.

rows.detailZh: 判断限于明确记录的帮助或成本；数值高低本身不构成判断。
rows.detailEn: Findings stay with explicitly recorded help or cost; numerical position alone is not a finding.

note.boundaryEn: A resource or friction finding needs a record of help or cost; numerical position alone is not such a finding.

units.zh: 理解决策，可以先把过程拆成察觉、理解、权衡、选择与调整。已有资料覆盖其中的部分主题，让你能够看见哪些问题已经有来源可读。它们可以连接起来提出问题，但并不等于已经观察到一条完整的个人决策链。
units.en: Understanding a decision starts by distinguishing noticing, understanding, weighing, choosing and adapting. The available material represents some of these topics, showing which questions already have a source to read. They can be connected to frame questions, without implying that a complete personal decision sequence has been observed.

units.zh: 在两个选项之间作决定时，可以分别记录自己注意到了什么、如何理解信息、保留了哪些优先事项，以及选择之后如何调整。这样能把“我怎么看待自己的思考”与“这一次实际上怎样作了决定”对照，也能看见某一步是否需要更多时间或支持。
units.en: When deciding between two options, record what drew your attention, how you understood the information, which priorities you retained and how you adjusted after choosing. This compares how you see your thinking with how this particular decision happened, including whether a step needed more time or support.

units.zh: 本页关注察觉、理解、权衡。下方保留的是决策过程中的证据入口。相关主题有资料，说明这一步有问题可以具体阅读；它不意味着在同一次决策中已经观察到这一步。
units.en: This page concerns Notice, Understand, Weigh. The entries below are evidence entry points into the decision process. A recorded topic gives that step a question to read concretely; it does not imply the step was observed in the same actual decision.

units.zh: 你的情绪与社交自陈，为理解关系中的自己提供了第一人称入口。它让表达感受、回应他人与调节互动成为可以细分的主题。其意义在于看清你如何描述自己的参与方式，而不是替另一个人说明他们如何体验你。
units.en: Your emotional and social self-report offers a first-person entry point into understanding yourself in relationships. Expressing feelings, responding to others and regulating an exchange become topics that can be examined separately. Its contribution is to clarify how you describe your participation, rather than speak for another person’s experience of you.

units.zh: 一次困难对话可以作为观察入口：你怎样描述自己的反应，对方实际说了什么，以及双方在什么条件下互动。把这几种资料分开记录，会比用单一关系标签更清楚地呈现自己的位置。
units.en: A difficult conversation can be an observation point: how you describe your response, what the other person actually said and the conditions of the exchange. Recording these separately gives a clearer view of your position than a single relationship label.

units.zh: 把这些视角分开，能看清关系理解中谁在说什么。自己的描述提供参与互动的第一人称位置；他人观察与共同事件增加的则是不同证据，而不是重复同一份自我看法。
units.en: Separating these perspectives clarifies who is describing what in a relationship reading. Your account gives a first-person position in an exchange; another person’s observation and a shared event add different evidence rather than repeat the same self-view.

note.boundaryEn: Two self-reports are not another person’s observations of you; interaction and relationship conditions need separate records.

units.zh: 已有 5 项任务记录，为工作阅读提供了完成具体问题的样本。它们的价值在于把讨论从笼统标签移向实际尝试：面对一个要求时做了什么、得到什么结果，以及哪些条件需要进一步核对。
units.en: 5 task records provide samples of addressing specific problems for the work reading. Their value is to move discussion from broad labels to actual attempts: what was done in response to a demand, what resulted and which conditions merit further comparison.

units.zh: 天赋、动机、环境、挑战、方向与贡献，是这一章的阅读视角。可以用一项工作记录逐步区分：什么吸引你开始，什么支持完成，什么在需求变化时变得困难，以及结果对他人有什么价值。这样形成的是可检验的问题，不是预先写好的职业答案。
units.en: Talents, motivation, environments, challenges, directions and contribution are reading lenses for this chapter. One work record can distinguish what draws you to begin, what supports completion, what becomes difficult when demands change and what the outcome contributes to others. This produces testable questions rather than a predetermined career answer.

units.zh: 这些层次把已有材料转成可观察的工作问题。先分清偏好、完成情况和条件，就能选择一项具体工作核对自己的运作，而不把开放问题提前写成职业方向。
units.en: These levels turn the material into work questions that can be observed. Distinguishing preference, completion and conditions helps select a piece of work through which to examine your functioning without prematurely converting an open question into a career direction.

units.zh: 当前可读的是你在不同经验领域中的自我描述模式。应对、作息、推理、情绪与价值即使出现相同数字，也仍在回答不同问题。把这些领域分别阅读，能保留你的自我理解的层次，而不是把它们压成一项总人格。
units.en: The current reading is your self-description across different areas of experience. Coping, routines, reasoning, emotion and values still answer different questions when their numbers are equal. Reading them separately preserves the layers of your self-understanding rather than compressing them into one overall personality.

units.zh: 将一次测评中的模式带到不同情境，需要新的观察。一处可核对的变化是：在熟悉任务与学习新任务之间，自己的描述是否对应相同的做法。这样才能把一次作答与跨情境稳定性区分。
units.en: Carrying a pattern from one assessment into different settings calls for a new observation. One comparison is whether your account corresponds to the same approach in a familiar task and while learning a new one. This distinguishes an assessment occasion from cross-situation stability.

units.zh: 本次自陈的已记录数字位置相同，因此这些作答没有在数值上区分各领域。可读之处是这种作答配置本身：它值得与每个领域的具体例子核对，而不能直接理解为各方面表现同样稳定。
units.en: The recorded numerical positions in this self-report are equal, so these responses do not distinguish the domains numerically. What can be read is the response configuration itself: it is worth comparing with a concrete example from each domain rather than treating every area of functioning as equally stable.

units.zh: 不同层次让人格阅读有明确位置：一次作答中的模式，可以是有意义的自我理解；跨情境稳定性与外部佐证则各需要与相应问题匹配的来源。
units.en: These levels give the personality reading a defined position. A pattern on one assessment occasion can be meaningful self-understanding; cross-situation stability and external corroboration each call for sources matched to their respective questions.

units.zh: 已有 1 条财务相关记录，让金钱事务可以按证据性质来阅读。自陈说明你如何理解能力或做法；知识样本说明这次回答了什么问题。把这两类贡献分别保存，能更清楚地看见已有理解与可以进一步核对的实践。
units.en: Your financial material contains 1 record. It can be read by evidence type. Self-report describes how you understand capability or practice; a knowledge sample shows how particular questions were answered. Keeping their contributions distinct clarifies the understanding already available and the practice that can be examined next.

units.zh: 一次意外支出能让几种问题分别显现：是否理解原则、是否认为自己有所准备、实际采用了什么做法，以及当时有哪些条件。这里把它作为核对证据的情境，不是个人财务建议；档案的作用是辨认每一种理解来自什么资料。
units.en: An unexpected expense can separate several questions: whether a principle is understood, whether you feel prepared, what was actually done and which conditions were available. Here it is a context for examining evidence rather than personal financial advice. The profile’s role is to identify the material behind each kind of understanding.

units.zh: 把财务证据按贡献分开，可以看清理解来自哪里。知道一个原则、描述自己的做法与实际资源，是不同问题；保留这种区别，能让已有资料有用而不越过个人档案的范围。
units.en: Separating financial evidence by contribution clarifies where understanding comes from. Knowing a principle, describing your approach and having resources are different questions. Preserving the distinction makes the material useful within the scope of a personal profile.

units.zh: 你的自陈中的财务能力记录，在这里保留其原始结果，供你与前面的阅读核对。每一项数值或文字回应自己的来源问题。
units.en: Your self-report provides the recorded results for Financial capability, retained here for comparison with the reading. Each value or statement addresses a source-specific question.

note.boundaryZh: 感知能力、知识、行为、资源与结果分别保留。本章仅表征证据，不提供现金流、资产负债、净值、投资组合分析或配置建议；原章节图的财务策略与长期预测不属于本次个人档案范围。
note.boundaryEn: Perceived capability, knowledge, behavior, resources and outcomes remain separate. This chapter characterizes evidence; it does not analyze cash flow, assets, liabilities, net worth or portfolios, or recommend allocations. Financial strategy and forecasting on the retained master are outside this profile.

units.zh: 把证据与当下生活连接，是让个人理解变得更具体的一步。现有记录已经为对照提供了主题：它可以与某一次行动、条件和结果核对。下表保留这些主题的当前状态，使值得检验的问题清楚可见。
units.en: Connecting evidence with current life makes personal understanding more specific. The records already provide topics for comparison with an action, its conditions and its outcome. The grid retains the current state of those topics, making the questions worth testing visible.

units.zh: 对照真正增加的不是一个更大的总分，而是更清楚的适用条件。一次截止期限、合作过程或优先事项变化，可以帮助区分描述何时贴近生活、何时需要调整。先核对一个明确主题，比让一次事件验证整份档案更有解释力。
units.en: A comparison adds clearer conditions of applicability rather than a larger overall score. A deadline, a collaboration or a change in priorities can distinguish when an account fits everyday life and when it needs adjustment. Examining one defined topic is more informative than asking one event to validate the entire profile.

units.zh: 每一行把已有主题与它实际连接的生活资料对应起来。状态说明这项连接目前能支持什么；尚未检验的行，则提供下一次观察的方向。
units.en: Each row relates a recorded topic to the everyday material actually linked to it. Its state shows what that connection currently supports; an untested row gives the next observation a direction.

note.boundaryZh: 现实状态限于实际连接的主题和情境；未连接的行保持尚未检验。方法报告的结论不在此综合。
note.boundaryEn: Reality states stay with the actually linked topic and setting; unlinked rows remain untested. Method-report conclusions are not synthesized here.

units.zh: 你的当前档案是一张仍可使用、也可更新的个人地图。来源身份与已记录的结果构成明确起点；自我理解、情境问题与待核对的联系，保留各自的层次。你可以从这张地图选择下一项最有意义的观察，而不必等待所有领域都有答案。
units.en: Your profile today is a usable personal map that can be updated. Source identity and recorded results provide a clear starting point; self-understanding, contextual questions and connections awaiting examination retain their separate levels. You can choose the next meaningful observation from this map without waiting for every domain to have an answer.

units.zh: 这张地图把明确记录、暂定理解与尚未观察的部分分开。下一项重要证据应当补充一种新视角或情境，使一个已有问题更清楚，而不仅是给相同材料增加标签。
units.en: This map separates definite records, provisional understanding and unobserved parts. The next meaningful evidence should add a perspective or setting that clarifies an existing question, rather than attach another label to the same material.

zh.text: 今天的档案包含 12 条证据记录，来自 3 类来源，覆盖 8 个已记录领域。这首先是一张关于已有资料的个人地图：其中 6 条来自自己的作答，让我们看见你如何理解若干方面的日常运作。

en.text: Today's profile contains 12 evidence records from 3 source classes, covering 8 recorded domains. This is a personal map of the material available: 6 records come from your own responses, showing how you understand several aspects of your functioning.

zh.text: 这些来源让档案能够分别阅读自我理解、测评结果或任务样本。它们的价值在于回答不同问题。明确的来源对照可帮助整理相同主题上的一致与分歧；来源数量本身不会使观点自动获得更多权威。

en.text: These sources let the profile read self-understanding, assessment results or task samples separately. Their value lies in answering different questions. An explicit comparison can organize agreement or disagreement on the same topic; source count alone does not give an account more authority.

zh.text: 这里的 8 个领域全部来自现有证据记录，包括适应与应对、身体与生活方式、认知导航、情绪与社交调节、财务能力、意义与价值、推理任务表现、IPIP 大五人格 · 开放性。它们是阅读材料的入口，而不是相互替代的能力分数。财务记录的具体结果在第八章集中呈现，但这个领域仍完整地属于当前证据结构。

en.text: All 8 domains here come from the evidence records: Adaptation and coping, Body and lifestyle, Cognitive navigation, Emotional and social regulation, Financial capability, Meaning and values, Reasoning task performance, IPIP Big Five · Openness. They are entry points into the material, rather than interchangeable ability scores. The detailed financial results appear together in chapter eight, while the domain remains fully represented in the evidence structure.

zh.text: 你的作答让应对压力与变化成为可讨论的经验领域：你已经提供了自己如何看待这部分运作的视角。被打断后重新安排步骤，是区分恢复节奏与持续承受负荷的一处观察点。

en.text: Your response makes coping with pressure and change a visible part of your self-view. It gives us your perspective on this area of functioning. Reorganizing steps after an interruption is one place to distinguish recovering your rhythm from sustaining a demanding workload.

zh.text: 你对身体照顾与日常节奏的看法已进入档案。这使作息、活动与察觉疲劳能够成为具体的观察主题；例如，可以比较计划中的节奏与某一天实际保留了哪些习惯。

en.text: Your view of bodily care and daily rhythm is part of the profile. Routines, activity and noticing fatigue become concrete topics to observe—for example, by comparing an intended routine with the habits actually retained on a particular day.

zh.text: 这一领域使信息理解、推理与落实之间的区别变得清楚。把一个问题说清楚，与在学习新任务时完成下一步，是相互关联却不同的经验；已有记录为核对这种区别提供了起点。

en.text: This area brings the distinction between understanding information, reasoning and following through into focus. Explaining a problem and completing the next step while learning a new task are related but different experiences. The recorded material offers a starting point for comparing them.

zh.text: 情绪与社交调节已成为你描述自己的一个角度。它让察觉感受、表达需要与回应他人能够分别讨论。在一次困难对话中，可以观察这几步如何衔接，而不把一次整体作答当成对整段关系的判断。

en.text: Emotional and social regulation is one angle through which you describe yourself. It allows noticing feelings, expressing needs and responding to another person to be discussed separately. A difficult conversation can reveal how these steps connect, without making one broad response a verdict on a relationship.

zh.text: 金钱事务在已有证据中有自己的位置。它使“如何理解财务能力”成为明确问题：觉得有所准备、理解一个原则与实际执行选择，可以分别核对。意外支出是一种可能让这些区别显现的情境。

en.text: Money-related demands have a place in the available evidence. They make how you understand financial capability a specific question: feeling prepared, understanding a principle and acting on a choice can be examined separately. An unexpected expense is one possible context in which these distinctions become visible.

zh.text: 意义与价值为理解优先事项提供了一个入口。已有描述可以与具体取舍对照：当时间、金钱或长期承诺彼此竞争时，哪些考虑被保留、哪些被调整。这样的核对能让价值从名称变成有情境的理解。

en.text: Meaning and values provide an entry point for understanding priorities. The recorded account can be compared with a concrete trade-off: when time, money or a long-term commitment competes for attention, which considerations are retained and which are adjusted? This makes values a contextual question rather than just a label.

zh.text: 推理任务表现为这份档案保留了一个来源明确的阅读主题。把该记录与一次具体任务或经历对照，能帮助区分来源中的描述与情境中发生的事情。

en.text: Reasoning task performance preserves a source-defined topic in this profile. Comparing that record with a specific task or episode helps distinguish the source account from what happened in a setting.

zh.text: IPIP 大五人格 · 开放性为这份档案保留了一个来源明确的阅读主题。把该记录与一次具体任务或经历对照，能帮助区分来源中的描述与情境中发生的事情。

en.text: IPIP Big Five · Openness preserves a source-defined topic in this profile. Comparing that record with a specific task or episode helps distinguish the source account from what happened in a setting.

zh.text: 关于适应与应对、认知导航、情绪与社交调节、意义与价值的自我描述，为资源与阻力提供了可检验的线索。这些主题可以帮助你区分：什么让一步行动更容易完成，什么在特定条件下增加消耗。当前最有用的读法，是保留线索并观察它在哪种要求下发挥作用。

en.text: Your self-description of Adaptation and coping, Cognitive navigation, Emotional and social regulation, Meaning and values offers testable leads for resources and friction. These topics can help distinguish what makes a next step easier from what adds effort under particular conditions. The useful reading is to retain the lead and observe the demands under which it matters.

zh.text: 同一种做法可能在安静、时间充足时帮助推进，在频繁打断或期限缩短时增加成本。一处可观察的区别是：完成任务是否依赖额外准备、他人支持或恢复时间。记录当时的要求、行动和结果，会比只给自己贴上“优点”或“弱点”的标签更能说明问题。

en.text: The same approach may help in a quiet setting with sufficient time and become costly when interruptions increase or a deadline shortens. One observable distinction is whether completion depends on extra preparation, another person’s support or recovery time. Recording the demands, action and outcome explains more than attaching a strength or weakness label.

zh.text: 理解决策，可以先把过程拆成察觉、理解、权衡、选择与调整。已有资料覆盖其中的部分主题，让你能够看见哪些问题已经有来源可读。它们可以连接起来提出问题，但并不等于已经观察到一条完整的个人决策链。

en.text: Understanding a decision starts by distinguishing noticing, understanding, weighing, choosing and adapting. The available material represents some of these topics, showing which questions already have a source to read. They can be connected to frame questions, without implying that a complete personal decision sequence has been observed.

zh.text: 在两个选项之间作决定时，可以分别记录自己注意到了什么、如何理解信息、保留了哪些优先事项，以及选择之后如何调整。这样能把“我怎么看待自己的思考”与“这一次实际上怎样作了决定”对照，也能看见某一步是否需要更多时间或支持。

en.text: When deciding between two options, record what drew your attention, how you understood the information, which priorities you retained and how you adjusted after choosing. This compares how you see your thinking with how this particular decision happened, including whether a step needed more time or support.

zh.text: 你的情绪与社交自陈，为理解关系中的自己提供了第一人称入口。它让表达感受、回应他人与调节互动成为可以细分的主题。其意义在于看清你如何描述自己的参与方式，而不是替另一个人说明他们如何体验你。

en.text: Your emotional and social self-report offers a first-person entry point into understanding yourself in relationships. Expressing feelings, responding to others and regulating an exchange become topics that can be examined separately. Its contribution is to clarify how you describe your participation, rather than speak for another person’s experience of you.

zh.text: 一次困难对话可以作为观察入口：你怎样描述自己的反应，对方实际说了什么，以及双方在什么条件下互动。把这几种资料分开记录，会比用单一关系标签更清楚地呈现自己的位置。

en.text: A difficult conversation can be an observation point: how you describe your response, what the other person actually said and the conditions of the exchange. Recording these separately gives a clearer view of your position than a single relationship label.

zh.text: 已有 5 项任务记录，为工作阅读提供了完成具体问题的样本。它们的价值在于把讨论从笼统标签移向实际尝试：面对一个要求时做了什么、得到什么结果，以及哪些条件需要进一步核对。

en.text: 5 task records provide samples of addressing specific problems for the work reading. Their value is to move discussion from broad labels to actual attempts: what was done in response to a demand, what resulted and which conditions merit further comparison.

zh.text: 天赋、动机、环境、挑战、方向与贡献，是这一章的阅读视角。可以用一项工作记录逐步区分：什么吸引你开始，什么支持完成，什么在需求变化时变得困难，以及结果对他人有什么价值。这样形成的是可检验的问题，不是预先写好的职业答案。

en.text: Talents, motivation, environments, challenges, directions and contribution are reading lenses for this chapter. One work record can distinguish what draws you to begin, what supports completion, what becomes difficult when demands change and what the outcome contributes to others. This produces testable questions rather than a predetermined career answer.

zh.text: 当前可读的是你在不同经验领域中的自我描述模式。应对、作息、推理、情绪与价值即使出现相同数字，也仍在回答不同问题。把这些领域分别阅读，能保留你的自我理解的层次，而不是把它们压成一项总人格。

en.text: The current reading is your self-description across different areas of experience. Coping, routines, reasoning, emotion and values still answer different questions when their numbers are equal. Reading them separately preserves the layers of your self-understanding rather than compressing them into one overall personality.

zh.text: 将一次测评中的模式带到不同情境，需要新的观察。一处可核对的变化是：在熟悉任务与学习新任务之间，自己的描述是否对应相同的做法。这样才能把一次作答与跨情境稳定性区分。

en.text: Carrying a pattern from one assessment into different settings calls for a new observation. One comparison is whether your account corresponds to the same approach in a familiar task and while learning a new one. This distinguishes an assessment occasion from cross-situation stability.

zh.text: 本次自陈的已记录数字位置相同，因此这些作答没有在数值上区分各领域。可读之处是这种作答配置本身：它值得与每个领域的具体例子核对，而不能直接理解为各方面表现同样稳定。

en.text: The recorded numerical positions in this self-report are equal, so these responses do not distinguish the domains numerically. What can be read is the response configuration itself: it is worth comparing with a concrete example from each domain rather than treating every area of functioning as equally stable.

Self-report describes how you understand capability or practice; a knowledge sample shows how particular questions were answered. Keeping their contributions distinct clarifies the understanding already available and the practice that can be examined next.

en.text: Source separation preserves each kind of material’s position in the map. The same topic can have different perspectives; this shows recorded coverage rather than combining sources into one measurement.

zh.text: 你的自陈中的适应与应对、身体与生活方式、认知导航记录，在这里保留其原始结果，供你与前面的阅读核对。每一项数值或文字回应自己的来源问题。

en.text: Your self-report provides the recorded results for Adaptation and coping, Body and lifestyle, Cognitive navigation, retained here for comparison with the reading. Each value or statement addresses a source-specific question.

zh.text: 你的自陈中的情绪与社交调节、意义与价值记录，在这里保留其原始结果，供你与前面的阅读核对。每一项数值或文字回应自己的来源问题。

en.text: Your self-report provides the recorded results for Emotional and social regulation, Meaning and values, retained here for comparison with the reading. Each value or statement addresses a source-specific question.

zh.text: 这里区分已观察到的帮助或成本，与值得检验的可能线索。看清这个区别，可以选择一次条件明确的行动来核对，而不急于把某种倾向定为优点或缺点。

en.text: This separates recorded help or cost from a possible lead worth testing. The distinction helps select an action with defined conditions for examination, rather than immediately treating a tendency as a strength or weakness.

zh.text: 本页关注察觉、理解、权衡。下方保留的是决策过程中的证据入口。相关主题有资料，说明这一步有问题可以具体阅读；它不意味着在同一次决策中已经观察到这一步。

en.text: This page concerns Notice, Understand, Weigh. The entries below are evidence entry points into the decision process. A recorded topic gives that step a question to read concretely; it does not imply the step was observed in the same actual decision.

en.text: This page concerns Choose, Adapt. The entries below are evidence entry points into the decision process. A recorded topic gives that step a question to read concretely; it does not imply the step was observed in the same actual decision.

zh.text: 把这些视角分开，能看清关系理解中谁在说什么。自己的描述提供参与互动的第一人称位置；他人观察与共同事件增加的则是不同证据，而不是重复同一份自我看法。

en.text: Separating these perspectives clarifies who is describing what in a relationship reading. Your account gives a first-person position in an exchange; another person’s observation and a shared event add different evidence rather than repeat the same self-view.

zh.text: 这些层次把已有材料转成可观察的工作问题。先分清偏好、完成情况和条件，就能选择一项具体工作核对自己的运作，而不把开放问题提前写成职业方向。

en.text: These levels turn the material into work questions that can be observed. Distinguishing preference, completion and conditions helps select a piece of work through which to examine your functioning without prematurely converting an open question into a career direction.

zh.text: 不同层次让人格阅读有明确位置：一次作答中的模式，可以是有意义的自我理解；跨情境稳定性与外部佐证则各需要与相应问题匹配的来源。

en.text: These levels give the personality reading a defined position. A pattern on one assessment occasion can be meaningful self-understanding; cross-situation stability and external corroboration each call for sources matched to their respective questions.

zh.text: 把财务证据按贡献分开，可以看清理解来自哪里。知道一个原则、描述自己的做法与实际资源，是不同问题；保留这种区别，能让已有资料有用而不越过个人档案的范围。

en.text: Separating financial evidence by contribution clarifies where understanding comes from. Knowing a principle, describing your approach and having resources are different questions. Preserving the distinction makes the material useful within the scope of a personal profile.

zh.text: 每一行把已有主题与它实际连接的生活资料对应起来。状态说明这项连接目前能支持什么；尚未检验的行，则提供下一次观察的方向。

en.text: Each row relates a recorded topic to the everyday material actually linked to it. Its state shows what that connection currently supports; an untested row gives the next observation a direction.

zh.text: 这张地图把明确记录、暂定理解与尚未观察的部分分开。下一项重要证据应当补充一种新视角或情境，使一个已有问题更清楚，而不仅是给相同材料增加标签。

en.text: This map separates definite records, provisional understanding and unobserved parts. The next meaningful evidence should add a perspective or setting that clarifies an existing question, rather than attach another label to the same material.
